language.title: Language
language.hint: Match system uses your computer's language when Buun Mail speaks it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Match system follows your computer between light and dark.

density.title: Message list
density.hint: Compact fits more messages on screen.

grain.title: Paper grain
grain.hint: A fine paper texture over the window.

workspaces.introDefault: Workspaces come from your routing file, <file/>. Edit it and restart to change which addresses land where. Give each workspace an icon or an image here; it is kept on this computer and wins over the file's <field/>.
workspaces.introAt: Workspaces come from your routing file at <file/>. Edit it and restart to change which addresses land where. Give each workspace an icon or an image here; it is kept on this computer and wins over the file's <field/>.
workspaces.imageUnreadable: That image could not be read.
workspaces.imageTooBig: That image is over {{megabytes}} MB. Pick a smaller one.

readingPane.title: Reading pane
readingPane.hint: Off lets the list fill the window; opening a message shows it in full, with Back to the list.

remember.title: Reopen where I left off
remember.hint: Opens on the folder and message you had open when Buun Mail closed, instead of the first inbox.

conversations.title: Group by conversation
conversations.hint: One row per conversation, showing its newest message, with replies and your sent answers gathered above the open message.

senderChecks.title: Sender checks and size in the list
senderChecks.hint: SPF, DKIM and DMARC for each message, as the receiving server found them, and its size. Point at one to see what it means.

security.sealedHint: Every API key, token and password Buun Mail keeps is encrypted on this computer with a key made for this install (vault.key in the config folder, readable only by you). Updates keep the key, so nothing needs entering again.
security.codeHint: Set a code to be asked before a saved key, token or password is shown again. Mail and alerts keep working without it.
security.codeSetHint: A code is set. It is asked before a saved secret is shown, then not again for five minutes.
security.mismatch: The two codes are not the same.
security.passkeyLater: Unlocking with a passkey, Touch ID or Windows Hello is planned; it depends on what each system offers.
